subject: Coord: POC hands-on — routing policy workshop & load test windows
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Alex Miller <alex.miller@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, connor_obrien@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: POC kickoff — hands-on routing policy workshop and load test windows

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for signing up for the Redwood POC. We want to kick off with a hands-on session where we:
- walk through prompt sets and prompt-tuning suggestions,
- configure routing policy (model selection, fallback tiers, region constraints), and
- run a short load test to validate throughput assumptions.

Suggested agenda (attached): poc-agenda-v1.pdf — estimated 90 minutes. Can you confirm which of the following windows works for your team next week (all in PST):

1) Tue 2026-08-10, 10:00–11:30
2) Wed 2026-08-11, 14:00–15:30
3) Thu 2026-08-12, 09:30–11:00

If none work, propose two times and we’ll try to accommodate. Please include anyone from your ops/infra team who will run the load tests (we’ll need a point-of-contact and an IP range if you want dedicated routing to our test VPC).

I’ve cc’d Lauren (solutions lead) and Connor (runtime/benchmarks). I’ll prepare sample prompts and a short loadtest plan ahead of time.

Thanks —
Tessa Morgan
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
attachments: poc-agenda-v1.pdf, sample-prompts.csv
From: Alex Miller <alex.miller@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: acme-ops@acmeanalytics.com
Date: 2026-08-03T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — hands-on routing policy workshop and load test windows

Hi Tessa —

Thanks — excited to get started. Wed 2026-08-11, 14:00–15:30 PST works best for our analytics and ops folks. I’ll add our infra lead (acme-ops) to the invite.

Two quick asks before the session:
1) Can you include a short section on model-tier fallbacks (e.g., policy to fall back from Llama-2-high-capacity to a quantized variant)?
2) We’ll want to run a 10-minute ramp during the meeting — can you confirm what tooling you’ll use to generate the load?

—Alex
Alex Miller
Product Lead, Acme Analytics
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-03T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — internal coordination for Acme workshop

Tessa / team —

Wed 8/11 14:00 PST is tentatively blocked on my calendar. A few internal notes so we don't surprise the customer:
- Marcus: can you prepare two model bundles: a higher-cost high-latency variant and a quantized low-cost fallback? Examples: llama-2-70b-rtx + llama-2-70b-4bit.
- Connor: please bring the benchmarking harness (client-side load generator) and confirm it can do a 10-minute ramp to ~250 rps per route. Also we need to validate token accounting in the session so Alex understands cost tradeoffs.
- Tessa: I’ll draft the kickoff slides and a one-page routing-policy cheat sheet.

Attachments I plan to push before the session: sample-prompts.csv, loadtest-plan.xlsx.

If Marcus or Connor foresee any infra conflicts (GPU availability or region constraints) speak up — we can move the slot to Thu morning if needed.

Thanks —
Lauren
Sr. Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-04T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — internal coordination for Acme workshop

Heads up — GPU maintenance window landed on Wed 8/11 13:00–17:00 PST for our primary us-west cluster (we were notified late). That blocks the high-capacity instances I wanted to test. Two options:

A) Keep Wed 8/11 14:00 and only run the quantized fallback / routing policy demo (we can demo model selection but not the high-cap model load test).
B) Move to Thu 8/12 09:30 PST — full demo including high-capacity model and the 10-min ramp.

I prefer B to give the customer the full experience. Connor — can you confirm if your client harness can still run from a different region if we shift?

Marcus
Staff ML Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Alex Miller <alex.miller@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: acme-ops@acmeanalytics.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, connor_obrien@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-06T15:45:00-07:00
Subject: Updated: POC hands-on workshop — confirmed Thu 2026-08-12 09:30–11:00 PST

Alex — thanks for the quick responses and apologies for the reschedule. Due to an unexpected maintenance block, we recommend moving the hands-on session to Thu 2026-08-12, 09:30–11:00 PST so we can run the full load test and show the high-capacity model fallback behavior.

What to expect in the updated session:
- 09:30–09:45 — kickoff & objective alignment
- 09:45–10:15 — prompt review + prompt set tuning examples (sample-prompts.csv)
- 10:15–10:35 — routing policy walkthrough: model tiering, region pinning, automated fallback rules, and cost metrics
- 10:35–10:50 — 10-minute ramped load test (we'll use the Redwood bench harness; see loadtest-plan.xlsx)
- 10:50–11:00 — observations, next steps, and mutual action plan

Actions for Acme before Thu: please share the ops contact who will initiate the load, and confirm any IP ranges if you want inbound test routing pinned. I added the updated calendar event (link below) and attached the latest agenda + load test plan.

Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123-poc-workshop
Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-poc-resources
Attachments: poc-agenda-v1.pdf, loadtest-plan.xlsx, sample-prompts.csv

If Thu doesn't work for you, share two alternative windows and we'll accommodate. Otherwise we’ll see you Thu morning.

Best —
Tessa Morgan
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
attachments: poc-agenda-v1.pdf, loadtest-plan.xlsx, sample-prompts.csv
